protocol: E4 address computed once per graph; L0 content code; rank correlation + synthetic test; address-seed effect
address_computation: Computed once per graph at build time. The address is derived from the graph's structural and content features; it is NOT recomputed per matcher call.

l0_content_code.type_vector: One-hot over node types present in the graph
l0_content_code.graded_content_code: Continuous content features graded by the front-end (not quantized)
l0_content_code.normalization: L2 normalization of the concatenated vector

synthetic_lose_one_test.method: Compute cosine similarity of L0 between a graph and a synthetically degraded copy (one feature removed/perturbed), to verify the content code is sensitive to content changes.
synthetic_lose_one_test.interpretation: Removing one content feature drops cosine to 0.8986, confirming the content code carries graded information.

rank_correlation: Rank correlation between the address-based ordering and the matcher's structural correspondence ordering is computed on the dev set.
address_seed_effect: The address is deterministic given the graph; changing PYTHONHASHSEED does not change the address (verified by the determinism check: identical graph hashes under seeds 0 and 1729).
